items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How'd you enjoy working with Hines? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he wasn't no trouble.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know. I heard that. And that was one of the things that interested me very much and, of corse I had to ask you. Now, pianists. You mentioned how Fatha Hines was always full of many switches and changes.
Yeah, poor Old Hines' mess you up too. Fatha Hines would change on you as quick as daylight. Liable
to be playing in A flat and he jump way down to D flat, you know, jump back into C. Oh, he's tricky, you got to watch him, know what you're doing.
